deviation: The 99.9% availability target matches the standard, but service credits are left "as agreed between the Parties in writing" instead of the fixed 5% of monthly fees per full 1% shortfall. Arcadia has no automatic credit entitlement, so a missed target may bring no financial remedy until a further agreement is reached. The draft also excludes scheduled maintenance, which the standard does not.
suggested_text: Service availability: The Supplier shall achieve at least 99.9% availability in each calendar month. Service credits: The Supplier shall issue service credits of 5% of the monthly fees for each full 1% shortfall below the availability target. Service credits are not the Customer's sole remedy. [Scheduled maintenance, if excluded, must be notified at least [x] days in advance and capped at [x] hours per month.]
